metadata.mode: Main-equivalent no scheduled commands, real processor.process() in Node VM; no browser/device deadline inference
metadata.timingInstrumentation: Two performance.now() calls per block; output arrays reused. Heap profiler and allocation instrumentation only in separate pass.
metadata.evidenceComposition: Timing nine-condition matrix from results.json, added owned-indexed HuC condition from indexed/results.json; allocation-only repeat allocation-pass/results.json snapshots counts before disposal. Different passes intentionally remain separate.
metadata.allocationLimit: V8 sampling is approximate and does not comprehensively account for external ArrayBuffer backing-store bytes. Calculate PCM payload/copy volume separately.

allocations.notes: Separate profiler pass, includes instrumentation wrappers; sampled allocation is approximate and is not the timing result. malloc/free counters exclude initialization and disposal.
